statement: An industry-wide headline Indian mobile tariff increase (entry/prepaid plan prices raised by >=10% by Airtel) is announced between 13-Oct-2026 and 30-Sep-2027
FY2027 consolidated capex (company-reported) exceeds FY2026's INR 47,522 crore by more than 5% (i.e. > INR 49,898 crore)
India mobile ARPU reported for Q4FY2027 is at least INR 280
Dividend per share recommended for FY2027 is at least INR 24
Bharti Group share of TRAI access-services AGR in QE Mar-2027 is at least 39.5%
No equity issuance (rights, QIP, preferential or share swap) raising the fully paid share count by more than 1% between 13-Oct-2026 and 31-Mar-2028
Consolidated net debt incl. leases to annualised EBITDA (company basis) is at or below 1.29x at 31-Mar-2027
